cc:Work.dc:description: For each modality and cohort group, bars show the fraction of jointly testable eligible sources passing the baseline-subtracted Q2 screen using pooled C1 controls, the pre-context C1 repeat, or the post-context C1 repeat. Labels give responsive/testable counts. Error bars for Neuropixels and mesoscope are 95% mouse-cluster bootstrap intervals; SLAP2 has two mice and no bootstrap intervals. Pooled C1 is the primary comparison.
